predict.question: Revising your essay, each error must be noticed, then diagnosed, then corrected, in that order. You can notice 10, diagnose 6 and correct 8 per minute. How many corrections per minute can you steadily finish?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Learn Like a Pro discusses using feedback to improve how one studies.
modelBoundary: Vague feedback permits {A}; diagnostic feedback {B}. Raising diagnosis capacity helps because diagnosis constrained this line.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Those capacities are invented; specific feedback need not multiply real learning by this ratio.
